name: Ca mo cat
summary: A local fish sold under two names, cá mó cát and cá mó sáp, and ordered with the island’s seafood meal.
origin: Côn Đảo. Báo Đồng Nai, 11 July 2025.
howToEat: Order it with the seafood meal.
seoTitle: Ca mo cat — cá mó in Con Dao
seoDescription: Cá mó cát, also called cá mó sáp, is one of the fish Côn Đảo is known for.
